claims: The 2026 NFL Draft will be held in Pittsburgh.
The 2026 NFL Draft will be held from Thursday, April 23, through Saturday, April 25, 2026.
The first round of the 2026 NFL Draft is on Thursday night.
The 2026 NFL Draft has live coverage on ESPN, ABC, and NFL Network.
Round 1 of the 2026 NFL Draft is on Thursday, April 23, at 8 p.m. ET.
Rounds 2–3 of the 2026 NFL Draft are on Friday, April 24, at 7 p.m. ET.
Rounds 4–7 of the 2026 NFL Draft are on Saturday, April 25, at 12 p.m. ET.
The 2026 NFL Draft marks the 91st annual meeting of NFL franchises selecting new players.
